g.text: Matched prior: posterior trees save continuation calls

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: PRIMARY SUPPORTED: 422 posterior calls versus 488 uniform; 13.52% reduction, required ≥2%.

text.style: font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: 4,096 IID truths from the declared prior conditioned on at least eight source positives; 909 sampled models.

text.style: font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: All policies identify the same 4,083 cases. All 13 infeasible cases, 3,855 prior successes and duplicates retained.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: The 66-call saving is 13.52% of continuation cost, but only 0.63% after adding 9,933 shared MAP calls.

text.style: font-size: 11.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Exact conditional-prior integer weights: 1,485 / 27 / 1 for zero / one / two added leaper orbits.

text.style: font-size: 11.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: 1,522 eligible models and 4,436 equiprobable tickets; all 19 ineligible catalog rows retained as context.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Finite-cohort result under the declared prior; no population 2% guarantee or arbitrary-rule claim.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Posterior expected nonincrease and equal per-case accuracy are correctness properties, separate from the primary.

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: BP AdamW: not measured. 11,344 charged membership calls. Study 10.825 CPU s / 49.014 wall s; 0 GPU s.
